actions.action: Tap leaf over white paper to look for thrips
Inspect undersides and new growth with 10x loupe
Place blue or yellow sticky traps around the room
Check flowers and buds for thrips
Isolate affected plants and inspect all 80 plants
Spray insecticidal soap, neem/horticultural oil, or spinosad including undersides every 5-7 days for 3-4 rounds
Drench soil with spinosad or apply beneficial nematodes
Release predatory mites (Amblyseius cucumeris or swirskii)
Apply systemic acetamiprid or imidacloprid on non-edible plants
Test spray on one leaf and wait 24-48 hours
